seo.title: PDF to Mind Map — AI that extracts structure and key points | MindMapAny
seo.metaDescription: Try our free AI PDF to mind map tool. Upload a paper, report or ebook and get a multi-level map whose nodes keep their source page numbers, with PNG, SVG and Markdown export.
h2: Upload a PDF and build the map here
